instruction: Move all watches from my amazon wish list to cart.
notes: Single-app task (amazon). The agent must log in, list the wish list (which reveals each entry's product and its product_type), and call move_product_from_wish_list_to_cart once per watch; the quantity argument is omitted so the whole wish-list quantity is moved, matching the evaluation that cart/wish-list quantities equal the originals. The exact number of watches is unknown up front; the model instantiates three watches plus one non-watch item (reference solution has 7 calls = passwords + login + show_wish_list + 3 moves + complete). (is-watch ?p) is a static fact that becomes usable only after (wish-list-shown); the move action requires it, so non-watch entries can never be moved and the wish list is otherwise untouched. supervisor-complete-task takes the three watch records as non-API parameters (with pairwise inequality) so its precondition is exactly the conjunction of the problem goal; it is the only action that asserts (task-completed) and every other action requires (not (task-completed)). No answer is passed to complete_task.
